description: The agent must: (1) Read Jordan's messy notes at tmp/scratch/jordan_backup_notes.txt; (2) Consult SKILL.md authoring documentation to understand the agentskills.io standard; (3) Create a directory named exactly `postgres-db-backup/` containing at minimum `SKILL.md`, `scripts/`, `references/`, and optionally `assets/`; (4) Write a SKILL.md with valid YAML frontmatter where `name: postgres-db-backup` (matching the directory name, lowercase+hyphens only, ≤64 chars), and a `description` field that is keyword-rich and between 1-1024 characters; (5) Keep SKILL.md under 500 lines — the proprietary trap here is that Jordan's notes contain a large technical appendix (pg_dump flags, S3 bucket policy, IAM, error handling history) which must NOT be inlined into SKILL.md but offloaded into the `references/` directory; (6) Since this is critical/fragile infrastructure (explicit in Jordan's notes), the agent must apply 'low freedom level' design, meaning the SKILL.md body must contain concrete commands/scripts rather than vague prose guidance; (7) The SKILL.md body must NOT contain bloat (historical context, IAM policy details, PagerDuty internals) that belongs in references/ — agents relying on general knowledge will tend to dump everything into SKILL.md without understanding the 500-line constraint and references/ separation pattern.
